description: Watermark a document per recipient and trace a leaked copy. Mode 'mark' takes text and a list of recipient names (up to 255) and returns one copy per recipient carrying that recipient's number as an 18-character invisible marker (U+2060 frame, 8-bit number plus 8-bit check written in U+200B and U+200C) after the first word and every twentieth word, plus a tracer key that stores the list; set spacing to also encode the pattern in no-break spaces. Mode 'trace' takes a leaked copy plus the same recipients or the key and returns the recipient, the copy number, how many markers were found and agreed, and a confidence level. Marks survive copy and paste but not retyping, screenshots, OCR or a hidden-character cleaner. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/leak-tracer/

key.description: Trace: the tracer key returned by mark, instead of recipients

recipients.description: Recipient names in order (mark: required; trace: this or key)

spacing.description: Mark: also encode the pattern as no-break spaces

text.description: Mark: the document. Trace: the leaked copy or fragment
